findings.claim: cmd_skill_registry runs the repair unconditionally after refresh_skill_registry returns. The engine's refresh can skip with exit 0 (no-project-marker), and the new golden (refresh/without-gentle-ai-skill-registry-refresh) shows the repair then writing .atl/skill-registry.md in a directory that is not a project. The updated SKILL.md says to stop when the refresh is skipped, but the command keeps going. The gentle-ai skip behavior in the base cannot be confirmed from the diff, so whether the commit caused this is unknown.
proof_refs: engine/installer/testdata/registry_pins.golden refresh/without-gentle-ai-skill-registry-refresh: 'Skill registry refresh skipped (no-project-marker)' followed by exit 0 and a repaired registry

evidence: Reviewed the whole diff for the registry refresh switch in bin/lib/skill_registry.sh.
Flags --force and --quiet are forwarded to the engine, and --no-gitignore is documented as a no-op in the code, CHANGELOG and tests, so no option is silently ignored.
The set -e behaviour of the [[ ... ]] && args+=(...) lines is safe because later statements follow them in the function.
The golden diffs match the intended engine output; no regression found beyond F1.
